battle.name: 芬蘭戰爭
battle.theater: 芬蘭南部與卡累利阿地峽
battle.brief: 1808年2月21日俄軍越境攻入芬蘭，瑞典守軍分佈各要塞而主力未集，戰局在維堡圍城、拉阿泰公路與奧拉瓦伊斯三役連失；俄軍以可拆裝的野砲配攻城砲組成砲火體系，全戰歷時十九個月，卡面這門野砲正是這套砲制的源頭。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 芬蘭戰爭亦稱俄瑞戰爭、第一次芬蘭戰爭，自1808年2月21日打至1809年9月17日。交戰一方是俄羅斯帝國，另一方是瑞典王國——芬蘭此時是瑞典王國的東部領土，與本土同受古斯塔夫四世·阿道夫統治。俄軍由皇帝亞歷山大一世統籌，波羅的海艦隊兼芬蘭總督弗里德里希·威廉·馮·布赫霍韋登任總指揮，陸軍分三路縱隊推進，作戰計劃出自斯普倫格波爾滕與蘇赫捷列寧；卡明斯基、圖奇科夫、巴格拉分任縱隊指揮，另有近百艘沿岸帆船與砲艇進入門戶水域。瑞典方面，芬蘭戰區先由阿夫·克萊爾克代將，3月2日起由威廉·毛里茨·克林斯波爾接掌，北方由托爾中將、南部由馮·韋格薩克少將分領，海軍由魯道夫·塞德斯特倫姆統率艦隊、阿德海姆斯特耶納率沿岸分艦隊，地方防務倚靠堡壘守軍與波羅的海民兵。俄軍圍攻維堡、施瓦特霍爾姆與蘇瓦博格要塞群，瑞典則以芬蘭游擊隊與群島登陸作戰消耗俄軍。英國於1808年2月8日與瑞典結盟，皇家海軍北上支援，但5月抵達哥德堡的英軍部隊並未登陸；丹麥同時對瑞典開戰，令瑞典腹背受敵。
countriesEn: The Finnish War, also called the Russo-Swedish War or the First Finnish War, was fought from 21 February 1808 to 17 September 1809. One side was the Russian Empire, the other the Kingdom of Sweden — Finland was then the eastern territory of the Swedish realm and shared the rule of King Gustav IV Adolf with the homeland. On the Russian side the war was directed by Emperor Alexander I; Friedrich Wilhelm von Buxhoeveden, commander of the Baltic Fleet and governor-general of Finland, held overall command, the land forces advanced in three columns, and the plans were drawn up by Generals Georg Magnus Sprengtporten and Jan Pieter van Suchtelen. Nikolay Kamensky, Nikolay Tuchkov and Pyotr Bagration led the separate columns, and close to a hundred coastal sailing vessels and gun sloops eventually entered the inner waters. On the Swedish side Lieutenant-General Karl Nathanael af Klercker commanded in Finland until Wilhelm Mauritz Klingspor took over on 2 March; Count Johan Kristoffer Toll held the north and Major-General Eberhard von Vegesack the south, the navy was commanded by Admiral Rudolf Cederström with a coastal squadron under Rear-Admiral Claes Hjelmstjerna, and local defence rested on the fortress garrisons and the Baltic provincial militia. The Russians besieged Vyborg, Svartholm and the fortress of Sveaborg, while the Swedes answered with Finnish partisan war and landings in the archipelago. Britain concluded an alliance with Sweden on 8 February 1808 and the Royal Navy came north, but the British troops that reached Gothenburg in May were never landed; at the same time Denmark was at war with Sweden, stretching the Swedish defence on two fronts.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩國，外加一位被廢黜的君主。瑞典國王古斯塔夫四世·阿道夫頑拒俄國的封鎖要求，又低估俄軍冬季進攻的可能，1809年3月被軍官團廢黜。威廉·毛里茨·克林斯波爾於1808年3月2日自本土抵達後接掌兵權，採取放棄赫梅林納、讓芬蘭軍北撤並堅守南部海岸要塞的方針，雖屢敗仍保住國土，1809年2月被免職，旋獲晉元帥。工程兵出身的喬治·卡爾·馮·多貝爾恩主持拉阿泰公路一線的野戰，1809年2月14日以縱隊與小口徑砲對抗俄軍縱隊與龍騎兵衝鋒，最終兵敗。斯文·奧古斯特·桑德爾斯率北方游擊隊深入卡累利阿，兩度威脅俄軍側後，卻因兵力不足未能改變大局。古斯塔夫·毛里茨·阿姆費爾特在奧斯陀博特尼亞組織芬蘭游擊隊，以破壞道路與襲擊後方遲滯俄軍。卡爾·約翰·阿德勒克魯茲與庫爾特·馮·塞特指揮西卡約基反擊，扭轉了1808年夏的敗局；瓦薩旅團指揮官卡爾·約翰·克隆斯泰特在拉坦折盡全團，翌年又在拉阿泰公路覆沒。俄方以布赫霍韋登總攬全局，卡明斯基率一萬一千人攻入薩翁，9月14日於奧拉瓦伊斯取勝；海軍方面有卡尼科夫率分艦隊入海，英方則有穆爾爵士率一萬四千兵進抵哥德堡。
peopleEn: The key figures straddle the two countries, and there is one monarch among them who was deposed in the course of it. Gustav IV Adolf of Sweden stubbornly refused the Russian demands for closure, and underestimated the likelihood of a Russian winter invasion; he was deposed by the officers in March 1809. Wilhelm Mauritz Klingspor reached the theatre and assumed command on 2 March 1808, and adopted the policy of abandoning Hämeenlinna, withdrawing the Finnish army northward and holding the coastal fortresses of the south; though repeatedly defeated he saved the country, was dismissed in February 1809 and was thereupon promoted to field marshal. The engineer Georg Carl von Döbeln directed the field fighting along the Raate road, and on 14 February 1809 fought a Russian column with his own column and light guns until a dragoon charge decided the day against him. Sven August Sandels led the northern partisans deep into Karelia and twice threatened the Russian flank and rear, though his numbers were too small to change the outcome. Gustaf Mauritz Armfelt organised the Finnish partisans in Ostrobothnia, wrecking roads and striking at the Russian rear to hold the advance up. Carl Johan Adlercreutz and Curt von Seth commanded the counter-stroke at Siikajoki and turned the summer of 1808; Carl Johan Cronstedt, who commanded the Vasa Regiment, lost the whole regiment at Ratan and was wiped out again on the Raate road the following year. On the Russian side Buxhoeveden directed everything, and Kamensky with eleven thousand men drove into Savonia and won at Oravais on 14 September; in the navy Khanikov led the detachments into the archipelago, while on the British side Sir John Moore brought fourteen thousand men as far as Gothenburg.
kits: 卡面這門野砲是十六世紀西班牙帝國的野戰砲型，設計重點在於整門砲可拆成砲身、砲架、附屬車與前車數件，由馬匹分載牽引，因而能與步兵縱隊同步行軍，讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。到1808年，這個傳統已演成兩軍的連屬野砲制度：俄軍師級單位配六磅連屬砲，騎兵旅配三磅輕砲，砲兵連自帶砲車、備用砲架與彈藥箱；俄軍使用的十磅「獨角獸」式野砲自十八世紀中期起即為陸軍標準，輕便耐操，適合北歐的林地與泥濘道路。瑞典方面，沿海要塞保有大量舊式銅砲，蘇瓦博格守軍擁有七百餘門砲，卻多數沒有可用砲架或缺乏火藥；施瓦特霍爾姆守軍七百人中僅約三分之一持有可用武器，堡內砲幾乎全部不能發射，說明北歐守軍的裝備早已脫節。芬蘭的哈米納砲兵學校培訓軍官與射手，所訓正是三磅、六磅與十二磅連屬野砲的射擊與列陣，這批軍官後來成為守軍在維堡與圖爾庫一線的砲兵骨幹。俄軍攻城時除野砲外還調來臼砲與攻城重砲，在維堡城外構築砲壘與包壘，並把從被焚艦船上拆下的砲改造成海岸堡壘。農民游擊隊則以長矛、獵槍與農具作戰，海上另有數十艘裝二十四磅砲的砲艇與小型帆船在群島水道爭奪。運輸方面，1809年冬季俄軍大量使用雪橇與輕便馬車穿越湖區與林道。
kitsEn: The field gun on the card is of the Spanish imperial type of the sixteenth century, and its whole point of design is that the piece could be broken down into gun, carriage, limber and trail, to be carried by several teams of horses, so that it could march in step with an infantry column and gave battle its first calculable artillery fire. By 1808 that tradition had developed into a regimental field gun system in both armies: the Russian divisional units had six-pounder regimental guns, the cavalry brigades three-pounder light guns, and the artillery trains brought their own gun wagons, spare carriages and ammunition boxes; the ten-pounder Unicorn type used by the Russian army had been the standard service piece since the middle of the eighteenth century, light and hard-wearing, well suited to northern woods and muddy roads. On the Swedish side the coastal fortresses held large numbers of old bronze guns: the garrison of Sveaborg had more than seven hundred pieces, yet most had no serviceable carriage or lacked powder; at Svartholm only about a third of the seven hundred men carried usable weapons and practically none of the fortress guns could be fired, which shows how far the equipment of the northern garrisons had fallen out of date. The artillery school at Hamina in Finland trained officers and gunners in the shooting and manoeuvring of three-, six- and twelve-pounder regimental field guns, and that body of men became the artillery backbone of the Swedish defences on the Vyborg and Turku lines. For the siege the Russians brought up mortars and heavy siege cannon as well as field guns, laid out batteries and trenches before Vyborg, and rebuilt guns stripped from burnt-out ships into coastal redoubts. The partisan bands fought with pikes, hunting guns and farm tools, while at sea some dozens of gun sloops carrying twenty-four-pounder guns and small sailing craft fought for the archipelago channels. On the logistics side the Russians made heavy use of sledges and light wagons to cross the lake districts and forest tracks in the winter of 1809.
tactics: 俄軍的戰法以縱隊急行軍與奇襲為主。計劃出自斯普倫格波爾滕與蘇赫捷列寧：利用1790年後修築的一線堡壘作跳板，在海面結冰、瑞典倚重海運補給的冬季發動進攻，分別由阿文科斯基—洛維薩線、波爾沃方向與卡累利阿—維堡方向三路插入，目標先控制南部芬蘭，再向奧盧與瓦薩推進，切斷瑞典主力北撤之路。俄軍避免正面會戰，多以合圍、追擊與分割各個分遣隊的方式作戰；卡明斯基縱隊在拉阿泰公路遭瑞典縱隊側擊時，隨即以龍騎兵衝鋒配合六磅砲火扭轉戰局，即是這種兵力的典範。瑞典方面採縱深防禦：主力退往內陸與北方，退出前破壞道路橋樑、焚燒圖爾庫船塢中近五十艘砲艇，避免被完整奪去；堡壘以火炮與步槍對攻城縱隊側射，蘇瓦博格與施瓦特霍爾姆的守軍靠射擊孔與反斜面火力拖住俄軍，維堡的俄軍攻城砲壘則與堡壘砲位對射，最後以縱隊攻佔外圍堡壘。1790年後新建的要塞採用棱堡與斜面城壘，攻城方必須用野砲群配臼砲壓制，再以工兵挖掘壕溝圍城，最終從正面突破。海上俄軍以沿岸帆船與砲艇編隊控制內海，瑞典分艦隊被迫退守淺水，8月英國戰列艦加入後在波羅的海追擊並殲滅俄方殘存戰列艦。北方戰線上，桑德爾斯與阿姆費爾特的游擊隊以小隊襲擊、破壞補給與伏擊縱隊的方式，迫使俄軍分兵護路，掩護了瑞典北撤的交通線。
tacticsEn: The Russian method rested on the column march and the surprise attack. The plan came from Sprengtporten and Suchtelen: to use the line of fortresses built after 1790 as staging grounds and to strike in the winter, when the sea froze and the Swedes, who relied on seaborne supply, could not be reinforced; three thrusts were to be made, by the Ahvenkoski–Loviisa line, in the Porvoo direction, and from Karelia towards Vyborg, the object being to take southern Finland first and then push on towards Oulu and Vaasa to cut off the Swedish main body. The Russians avoided set-piece battle and worked instead by encirclement, pursuit and the destruction of detachments one by one; when Kamensky's column was struck from the flank on the Raate road, the dragoon charge combined with the six-pounder batteries turned the day, a typical example of that kind of force. The Swedes fought a defence in depth: the main body withdrew inland and northward, wrecking bridges and burning the nearly fifty gun sloops in the Turku dockyard so that nothing fell into Russian hands intact; fortresses answered the besieging columns with enfilading fire from guns and muskets, the garrisons of Sveaborg and Svartholm held the Russians off with fire from the embrasures and from the reverse slopes, and at Vyborg the Russian batteries traded shot with the fortress guns until the outer works were taken by storm. The fortresses built after 1790 used the bastioned trace with sloped glacis, so that the besiegers had to press home with field-gun groups and mortars, to open trenches with the engineers, and only then to force the line. At sea the Russians formed the coastal sailing vessels and gun sloops into squadrons that dominated the inner sea and forced the Swedish coast squadron back into shallow water, and when British ships of the line joined in August they pursued the Russian remnants across the Baltic and destroyed the last of them. On the northern front the partisans of Sandels and Armfelt struck in small parties, destroyed supplies and ambushed columns, forcing the Russians to detach troops for escort duty and thereby covering the Swedish line of march to the north.
data: 可引用的數字大致如下。1808年2月21日，越境的俄軍在布赫霍韋登指揮下約二萬四千人，當日攻下洛維薩；同時瑞典在芬蘭各堡壘與城鎮的駐軍合計約二萬一千人，但多數分散固守，主力未能及時集結，戰爭直到4月才正式宣戰。施瓦特霍爾姆守軍七百人，圍城自2月21日至3月18日約一個月，守軍僅一人作戰受傷，堡壘因火藥不足、砲無砲架而陷落。蘇瓦博格守軍六千人、七百餘門砲與足夠支撐到夏天的糧彈，5月6日在談判後投降，瑞典群島艦隊主力連同大批火藥軍械為俄軍所獲。1808年8月俄軍增援後兵力增至約五萬五千人，瑞典方面的估計為三萬六千人，卡明斯基一軍約一萬一千人；9月14日奧拉瓦伊斯之役後，9月29日布赫霍韋登與托爾簽署停戰，沙皇拒絕批准，並於12月撤換總指揮。1808年夏秋的海戰中，俄方在群島內投入近百艘沿岸帆船與砲艇，瑞典方面只有七艘划艇與三十艘砲艇，8月25日英方兩艘戰列艦追擊並焚毀俄方最後一艘戰列艦。1809年2月14日拉阿泰公路，瑞典縱隊約一千六百人幾乎全滅，一千三百至一千五百人被俘，兩門野砲淪陷。戰爭自1808年2月21日至1809年9月17日，前後約十九個月；芬蘭面積約三十六萬平方公里，戰前人口不足一百萬；俄國以維堡、漢科、蘇瓦博格與圖爾庫為基地，控扼波羅的海東岸。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. On 21 February 1808 the invading Russian army, under Buxhoeveden, numbered about twenty-four thousand and took Loviisa on the same day; the Swedish troops stationed in the fortresses and towns of Finland at the same time totalled about twenty-one thousand, but most were dispersed in fixed garrisons and the main force could not be assembled in time, and war was not formally declared until April. The garrison of Svartholm was seven hundred men, and the siege ran from 21 February to 18 March, about a month, in which only one man was wounded in action before the fortress fell for want of powder and serviceable gun carriages. Sveaborg had six thousand men, more than seven hundred guns and stores sufficient to last until the summer; it surrendered after negotiation on 6 May, and the main body of the Swedish archipelago fleet together with large quantities of powder and munitions passed intact to the Russians. After reinforcements the Russian strength rose to about fifty-five thousand in August 1808, against a Swedish estimate of thirty-six thousand, with Kamensky's corps numbering some eleven thousand; after Oravais on 14 September, Buxhoeveden and Toll signed an armistice on 29 September, which the emperor refused to ratify, replacing the commander-in-chief in December. In the fighting at sea in the summer and autumn of 1808 the Russians brought close to a hundred coastal sailing vessels and gun sloops into the archipelago, while Sweden could deploy only seven galleys and thirty gun sloops, and on 25 August two British ships of the line pursued and burned the last Russian ship of the line. On the Raate road on 14 February 1809 a Swedish column of about sixteen hundred men was almost annihilated, thirteen hundred to fifteen hundred men were taken prisoner and two field guns were lost. The war ran from 21 February 1808 to 17 September 1809, some nineteen months; Finland has an area of roughly three hundred and sixty thousand square kilometres and had a population of under a million before the war; Russia used Vyborg, Hanko, Sveaborg and Turku as bases commanding the eastern Baltic.
cause: 遠因是拿破崙戰爭把北歐拖入大陸體系。1807年7月的提爾西特條約後俄法結盟，亞歷山大一世致函瑞典國王古斯塔夫四世，要求芬蘭遵守條約限制，實質是切斷瑞典與英國的貿易；國王視拿破崙為反基督者，不肯放棄與英國的商路，又在1808年2月8日與英國訂立同盟。俄國隨後依1780年與1800年條約要求瑞典封閉波羅的海、不准入外國軍艦，國王拖延回覆，1807年12月30日俄方宣告若無明確答覆即將動手。直接導火線是1808年2月21日布赫霍韋登率二萬四千人越境攻入芬蘭並奪取洛維薩——這是芬蘭戰爭真正的開始日，遠早於正式宣戰。瑞典的困境在於自身準備崩壞：國王認定冬季不可能打仗，軍隊在本土與丹麥方向之間無法兩全，芬蘭邊防只靠殘存守軍；丹麥又於1808年進攻瑞典本土；軍官欠餉、裝備失修，施瓦特霍爾姆守軍只有三分之一人持有可用武器便是最露骨的例子。加上1807至1808年的財政崩潰與停發軍餉，瑞典在開戰時幾乎無法以野戰方式應戰。俄方則有計畫、有兵源、有砲兵，冬季進攻的想法正是針對瑞典的海運補給而來。
causeEn: The remote cause was the dragging of the north into the Continental system by the Napoleonic Wars. After the Treaty of Tilsit of July 1807 Russia and France were allied, and Alexander I wrote to King Gustav IV Adolf requiring Finland to respect the restrictions of the treaty, which in practice meant cutting Sweden off from trade with Britain. The king looked on Napoleon as the Antichrist, refused to give up Swedish commerce with Britain, and on 8 February 1808 concluded an alliance with Britain. Russia then demanded, on the strength of the treaties of 1780 and 1800, that Sweden close the Baltic to foreign warships; the king procrastinated, and on 30 December 1807 Russia declared that it would act if no clear answer came. The immediate spark was 21 February 1808, when Buxhoeveden crossed the border with some twenty-four thousand men and took Loviisa — the real opening date of the Finnish War, long before any formal declaration. Sweden's predicament lay in the collapse of its own preparations: the king believed no war could be fought in winter, the army could not be in two places at once against Denmark and the east, and the frontier of Finland rested on scattered garrisons; Denmark attacked the Swedish homeland in 1808 as well, and the officers were underpaid and the equipment rotten, of which the Svartholm garrison, only a third of it armed, is the plainest example. With the financial crash of 1807 and 1808 and arrears of pay left unpaid, Sweden could scarcely fight a field war at all when the war began. Russia, by contrast, had plans, manpower and artillery, and the idea of a winter offensive was aimed precisely at Swedish seaborne supply.
impact: 這一役把北歐的邊界整條改寫。瑞典失去佔本土三分之一的東部芬蘭與全部奧蘭群島，國防重心被迫轉向挪威與丹麥方向，十八世紀以來瑞典在波羅的海東岸的天然屏障消失。芬蘭在1809年成為俄羅斯帝國的大公國，首任總督由沙皇任命；此後芬蘭的港口與人口持續供應聖彼得堡，例如1812年俄國再對法開戰時，芬蘭提供了大量人力與糧秣，使俄軍得以在境外作戰而無後顧之憂。波羅的海的戰略地圖亦因此改寫：俄國取得維堡、漢科、蘇瓦博格與圖爾庫等要塞與群島基地，同時憑藉北德意志海與法國的船廠在短時間內重建海軍，而英國在北方失去了一個可靠的基地與盟友。瑞典內部則由此催化改革：1809年議會通過新憲法，國王古斯塔夫四世被廢，1818年貝納多特王朝建立，國家體制由軍王獨裁轉向議會與王權共治。軍術層面，芬蘭的森林、湖泊、積雪與泥濘道路讓雙方都明白，野砲的可拆卸與可重裝配是唯一能在這種地形裡保持火力連續的辦法，砲兵的使用從此更依賴每門砲的獨立機動而非固定砲壘。北方游擊隊在戰役中牽制住相當數量的俄軍，這種以小隊擾敵、破壞道路與遲滯縱隊的做法，此後成為芬蘭軍隊的傳統。
impactEn: This war rewrote the northern frontier outright. Sweden lost its eastern third, Finland, together with the whole of Åland, and its defence had to turn towards Norway and Denmark; the natural shield Sweden had held on the eastern Baltic since the eighteenth century was gone. Finland became the Grand Duchy of Finland within the Russian Empire in 1809, with a governor-general appointed by the tsar, and its ports and people thereafter fed St Petersburg continuously: when Russia went to war with France again in 1812, Finland supplied large numbers of men and provisions, allowing the Russian army to fight abroad without anxiety at home. The strategic map of the Baltic changed with it. Russia acquired the fortresses and archipelago bases of Vyborg, Hanko, Sveaborg and Turku, and at the same time rebuilt a navy in a short space of time by means of the North German yards and the French shipyards, while Britain lost a reliable base and ally in the north. Inside Sweden the war also drove reform: parliament passed a new constitution in 1809, Gustav IV Adolf was deposed, and the Bernadotte dynasty was established in 1818, the state turning from military absolutism towards a crown working with parliament. On the military level the forests, lakes, snow and muddy roads of Finland taught both sides that the only way to keep the fire continuous in that country was the field gun's capacity to be broken down and reassembled, and artillery came to depend more on the independent mobility of each piece than on fixed batteries. The partisan bands in the north held a substantial part of the Russian army in play, and this practice of small parties harrying the enemy, wrecking the roads and holding up the columns passed into the tradition of the Finnish force.
result: 結果是俄軍全勝。1808年冬春，俄軍在兩個多月內連下洛維薩、波爾沃、赫爾辛基、圖爾庫、瓦薩與庫奧皮奧，奪取施瓦特霍爾姆與蘇瓦博格兩座海防要塞，維堡要塞在圍城砲火與突擊下陷落，瑞典主力退往北方並在奧拉瓦伊斯再遭挫敗；1809年春季俄軍恢復進攻，瑞典在拉阿泰公路再失去一個縱隊與兩門野砲，國王被廢、議會改組，戰局已無轉機。1809年9月17日《腓特烈港條約》簽訂，瑞典放棄對芬蘭的一切主權，芬蘭連同奧蘭群島割予俄羅斯，成為自治的大公國，瑞典則被迫加入大陸封鎖體系並投入反法同盟。裝備層面的結論同樣清楚：卡面這門野砲所代表的可拆卸、可分車牽引的火砲體系，證明野戰火力必須能隨縱隊移動，但北歐的森林、泥路與冬季結冰同樣限制了一切砲兵優勢；守方在缺乏可用武器、缺乏砲架與火藥的狀態下，堡壘再堅固也守不住。這場戰爭最終由後勤、財政與國家動員能力的差距決定，而不是由任何一件單獨的兵器決定。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Russian victory. In the winter and spring of 1808 the Russians took Loviisa, Porvoo, Helsinki, Turku, Vaasa and Kuopio in the space of a little over two months, seized the coastal fortresses of Svartholm and Sveaborg, and reduced Vyborg to a fall under siege fire and assault, while the Swedish main body withdrew northward and was checked again at Oravais. In the spring of 1809 the Russians resumed the offensive, the Swedes lost another column and two field guns on the Raate road, the king was deposed and parliament reorganised, and the war could no longer be recovered. On 17 September 1809 the Treaty of Fredrikshamn was signed: Sweden renounced all sovereignty over Finland, Finland with Åland passed to Russia as an autonomous grand duchy, and Sweden was forced into the Continental system and into the coalition against France. The conclusion on equipment is equally plain. The system the field gun on the card represents — a piece broken down and carried forward on several separate wagons — showed that field fire has to be able to move with the column, but the forests, the mud and the winter ice of the north limited every advantage of artillery just as much. On the defensive side, with no serviceable weapons, no gun carriages and no powder, the strongest fortress in the world could not be held. In the end this war was decided by logistics, by finance and by the difference in national mobilisation, and not by any single weapon.
